site_title: MkFast Lite — A smaller start for a faster site
site_description: A minimal bilingual web starter with React, TanStack Start, dark mode, SEO, and Cloudflare Workers deployment.
hero_badge: ONE LANDING PAGE · ZERO BACKEND BAGGAGE
hero_description: MkFast Lite gives you the public-facing foundation for a focused website—bilingual content, dark mode, SEO, tests, and a one-command Cloudflare deploy—without a SaaS hiding underneath.
foundation_title: The useful middle between a blank repo and a full SaaS.
foundation_description: A blank project still needs design, routing, localization, metadata, accessibility, tests, and deployment. A SaaS starter brings accounts and infrastructure. MkFast Lite keeps the first list and removes the second.
foundation_quote: Start with the website you need, not the product you might build later.
stack_title: A familiar stack, cut to the essentials.
stack_description: Use the same modern tools across development and production, with every dependency tied to something visitors can actually use.
stack_react_detail: A current component model with no application-state framework added by default.
stack_tanstack_detail: File-based routing and server rendering for a fast, indexable public site.
stack_i18n_detail: Type-safe English and Chinese source messages with localized URLs.
stack_cloudflare_detail: One global deployment with no database, bucket, KV namespace, or secret setup.
architecture_title: The structure stays obvious as the site grows.
architecture_description: Routes own pages. Components own presentation. Locale files own words. Configuration owns site identity. Nothing is hidden behind a module registry.
architecture_routes_detail: Home, localized home, and machine-readable SEO endpoints.
architecture_components_detail: Small layout, theme, and landing-page building blocks.
architecture_content_detail: Matching locale sources for every visible string.
architecture_delivery_detail: Vite build to a Cloudflare Worker, with workers.dev enabled by default.
template_title: Change four things. Make it yours.
template_description: The starter is intentionally easy to take apart. Product identity and copy live in predictable places, and the page sections do not depend on backend state.
template_step_1_detail: Update the central website configuration and original brand assets.
template_step_2_detail: Replace the English and Chinese source messages with your own story.
template_step_3_detail: Reorder or remove independent homepage sections and theme tokens.
template_step_4_detail: Run the checks, then deploy to your workers.dev address.
template_repo_detail: Fresh history. Clean dependencies. Ready for your next small website.
faq_1_q: Is MkFast Lite a SaaS starter?
faq_1_a: No. It is deliberately a public-website starter. It has no accounts, billing, persistence, transactional email, or admin surface.
faq_2_a: Yes. TanStack Router remains in place, so adding a focused About, Docs, or Contact page is straightforward without shipping those pages by default.
faq_3_q: Does it require a Cloudflare database or storage bucket?
faq_3_a: No. The default Worker has no D1, R2, or KV bindings and needs no application secrets.
faq_4_q: Can I use my own domain?
faq_4_a: Yes. The template deploys to workers.dev by default, and you can attach a custom domain when your site is ready.
closing_title: The simple site should be the simple project.
closing_description: Start with a complete public experience, keep the code easy to understand, and add only what your website proves it needs.
footer_tagline: A minimal bilingual website starter for Cloudflare Workers.
